notes.title: Demo Update Log
notes.content:
We are glad to announce the first update of the demo version. The team works really hard to solve every issue coming up. Here are some changes/improvements from the previous patch. You can now play the updated version of the demo. Do not forget that tomorrow PHOBOS SUBHUMAN DEMO will be available for everyone.

Bug fixes in some collectables after extensive testing.
Bug fixes in enemy roaming after extensive testing.
English subtitles in all game speech.
Richer sound design.
Several other tweaks.
